criteria.text: Connected curated OpenAI rows with unverified entitlement remain selectable while stale models are absent.
A localhost custom provider is probed without forwarding authorization and a declared available model is selectable.
A configured public custom provider is not probed and remains selectable with unknown availability.
Protocol-relative and backslash base-path escapes make no outbound request.
A live OpenRouter fallback model remains visible by default unless explicitly hidden.
OpenRouter duplicate suppression is display-only and agent-scoped, and treats an authorized direct row with availability other than false as present.
Options-only, environment-authorized, and OpenCode Zen providers are not dropped.
Unauthorized providers receive provider-level Connect rows without invented model IDs.

Resolver default order is unchanged; automatic selection never picks custom providers or local providers while an authorized cloud route exists, and falls back to Ollama when it is the only authorized route.
A connected direct Anthropic override with unknown entitlement is accepted.
Hidden, disconnected, and explicitly unavailable overrides are rejected.
A failed engine config reload returns restart_required with reason reload_failed.
Provider drift returns restart_required with reason provider_drift; an in-sync refresh returns ok.
Loopback inventory intersection is read-only, bounded, and credential-free.
Public, link-local, metadata, userinfo, IPv6-mapped, private-host, and mismatched-origin probes are rejected.
Inventory redirects are refused and never followed across origins.
Provider snapshots expose only effective endpoint origin and source metadata, with secret-free digests.
An engine-managed models override without baseURL stays selectable.
Live reload detects newly declared provider drift without falsely claiming activation.
A live fresh boot instantiates the declared provider and never invents an undeclared inventory row.
Anthropic visibility keeps only the newest canonical model per active family.
Anthropic family parsing supports future families and one-part major versions without a hard-coded family enum.
Validated OpenAI model_usage entitlements set true and false availability while omitted keys stay unknown.
Missing or malformed OpenAI model_usage fails to wholly unknown, never false denial.
Gemini quota labels are intersected with eligible chat models; image, TTS, and embedding rows stay absent.
Unavailable Gemini quota data falls back to approved chat rows with unknown availability.
Catalog entitlement reads use only the usage cache, make no provider request, and log no token or account identifier.
Usage budgets expose only validated boolean model_usage entries.
Malformed model_usage is omitted rather than interpreted as denial.
Unprobeable query-string and engine-resolved environment-substitution endpoints remain selectable with unknown availability and are never probed.
Resolver-selected direct routes map stale static family IDs to a picker-visible policy model.
Built-in providers with a baseURL override retain direct-provider policy and agent kind.
OpenRouter duplicate suppression counts unknown direct entitlement as present.
Each resolver default is present in the public and per-agent catalogs for representative provider snapshots.
OpenRouter suppression is authorization-based, handles provider/model ID-shape differences, and remains agent-scoped.
A credential-free built-in config block does not authorize a provider; options.apiKey and environment sources do.
Proxy-configured built-in providers are not treated as declared-only custom providers.
Provider Connect rows are excluded from profile and playbook selectable-model dropdowns.
Anthropic-only and Copilot-only resolver defaults are catalog-visible and selectable.
Built-in authorization uses credential evidence consistently in snapshots, catalog rows, and resolver selection.
A built-in provider with a baseURL override remains on its normal direct-provider route.
The first refresh after provider options change reports restart_required from the engine boot baseline.
Query-string endpoints and 401 inventory replies remain selectable with unknown availability.
Canonical #639 suppression remains enabled for direct Anthropic plus OpenRouter.
The built-in direct allowlist is recorded as an explicit product decision.
Regression coverage protects dated Anthropic ranking, Copilot policy, opencode agent mapping, variants, hostname endpoints, per-agent OpenRouter rows, and Zen overrides.
Resolver contract wording permits Ollama only when no authorized cloud route exists and is backed by a genuinely failing old-code catalog-membership assertion.
Real authenticated-account picker behavior matches the provider entitlement payload shapes used by production accounts.
criteria.reason: The bounded lane has no real provider credentials. AJ must perform the requested real-account picker check; synthetic tests intentionally make no model-provider calls.
